findings.problem: "So it cancels" is the shortcut word; the student hears the reason (a common factor) but never sees that the first fraction becomes 4 before the next line drops it in.
findings.fix: Say "dividing the top and the bottom by X plus one leaves four" in place of "so it cancels", keeping the first fraction lit as it is said.

findings.problem: "A is four" lights the 4, but on "B is negative two" the −2 over x + 1 is not lit, so the student must work out which part is b.
findings.fix: Wrap the −2 in line 5 as its own piece and light it in a second colour on "B is negative two", alongside the a = 4, b = −2 note.

findings.problem: The second half of the plan, using the sign of b/(x+1) to see where the curve sits, is only spoken; nothing on the board shows it.
findings.fix: Fold this sentence into beat 4 or drop it, since beats 10–13 show the sign working on the board when it is used.
